verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page confirms that a ported number is included per user, so the product does accept number ports. Nothing in the evidence describes how the port is handled. missing for 10: documentation that Quo collects the losing carrier's account details, documentation that it collects a letter of authorization, documentation that Quo itself files and manages the port, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of the porting process.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my existing number in: the provider collects the losing carrier's account details and letter of authorization and files the port

citations.quote: One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
